title: Deer dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- ground shadow -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='92' rx='28' ry='4' fill='#3a2a5a'/>
  <!-- back legs (dancing, one lifted) -->
  <path d='M42 78 L38 90 L33 90 L37 79 Z' fill='#a86a2e'/>
  <path d='M46 78 L48 88 L53 88 L50 78 Z' fill='#8a5220'/>
  <!-- front legs -->
  <path d='M58 76 L60 90 L65 90 L62 76 Z' fill='#a86a2e'/>
  <path d='M62 74 L68 84 L72 81 L66 72 Z' fill='#8a5220'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='52' cy='68' rx='16' ry='11' fill='#c47f38' transform='rotate(-12 52 68)'/>
  <!-- chest lighter -->
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='70' rx='7' ry='8' fill='#e8b06a' transform='rotate(-12 60 70)'/>
  <!-- neck -->
  <path d='M60 60 L66 48 L72 50 L66 64 Z' fill='#c47f38'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='70' cy='44' rx='9' ry='8' fill='#d98f42'/>
  <!-- ear -->
  <path d='M66 37 L60 27 L68 33 Z' fill='#a86a2e'/>
  <!-- snout -->
  <ellipse cx='78' cy='46' rx='5' ry='4' fill='#e8b06a'/>
  <circle cx='81' cy='45' r='1.6' fill='#5a2a1a'/>
  <!-- eye -->
  <circle cx='71' cy='42' r='1.8' fill='#2a1a4a'/>
  <!-- antlers -->
  <path d='M68 36 L64 24 L60 18 M64 24 L70 18 M66 30 L72 26' stroke='#c8a050' stroke-width='2.4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M72 36 L78 26 L84 22 M78 26 L76 18' stroke='#c8a050' stroke-width='2.4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M37 64 L30 58 L34 66 Z' fill='#e8b06a'/>
  <!-- raised hoof sparkle -->
  <circle cx='71' cy='82' r='1.5' fill='#ffe08a'/>
  <circle cx='34' cy='91' r='1.5' fill='#ffe08a'/>
</svg>
